transcript: AGENT: Hi, thanks for calling MultiTracks Playback support. I'm an AI assistant. What can I help you with today?
CALLER: Hi, my song won't download. It keeps saying download error
AGENT: What device are you running Playback on?
CALLER: I'm on an iPad, Playback version eight point six point two. We don't play until Sunday so I have time
AGENT: For that "Download Error," tap "Try again" two times; does it still show the same message after the second attempt?
CALLER: Okay, I tried that and it still says download error

AGENT: Remove and re-add just that song: tap Edit, tap the red minus beside it, then tap "Add Song" and load it again. That removes its local download, so it'll need to download again. Does it download successfully after you add it back?
CALLER: Thanks. That's all I needed. Bye
